summary: Full backend + UI E2E test of the MyVolt Platform Admin 'Add Company' onboarding flow (company + first company_admin). Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding.py — 14/14 PASS (platform login/role, /platform/summary, 403 for non-platform, fabric + fleet company creation with correct industry/modules/plan/status, GET persistence + users=1, duplicate code 400, duplicate email 400 with no orphan org, missing name 400, organization_id injection ignored (server-side link honoured), new admin login payload (role=company_admin, industry, org_name), org isolation (0 orders / 0 vehicles), 403 on /platform for fleet admin, Route39 (284 vehicles) + Nayara (24 orders) regression). Frontend E2E: platform login -> /platform/dashboard; Companies -> Add Company; both sections and all 10 field testids present; slug auto-fill 'QA Weave Co' -> 'qa-weave-co'; code editable and no longer overwritten after manual edit; client validation toasts ('Admin name is required', 'Temporary password must be at least 6 characters') and no submit; FABRIC company created -> onboard-success with Company=QA UI Weave / Industry=Fabric Order Management / Admin=UI Fabric Admin / Admin Email=ui.fabric@qaui.com; Open Company -> /platform/companies/qa-ui-weave showing modules dashboard, orders, customers, reports, settings; FLEET company created -> Industry=Fleet & Rental; Back to Companies -> list shows both new rows with 1 user each; duplicate code toast 'Company code already exists'; duplicate email toast 'Admin email already exists'. New fabric admin logs in via generic login -> /dashboard = fabric dashboard (0 orders, empty Orders board, only Dashboard/Orders/Customers/Reports/Settings nav, no fleet copy); new fleet admin -> fleet dashboard (all KPIs 0, fleet nav, empty Fleet page), no order board; both redirected off /platform/*. Regression: Route39 admin fleet dashboard intact (284), Nayara admin 24 order cards. Auth playbook spot-checks: all password_hash start with $2b$12$, httpOnly+Secure access_token/refresh_token cookies set on login, brute-force lockout returns 429 after 5 failed attempts. ALL test data cleaned from Mongo (orgs qa-ui-weave, qa-ui-fleet, qa-api-* and their users deleted; only route39-org, nayara-org, platform remain; 9 users; Route39 284 vehicles / Nayara 24 orders verified untouched).

minor.issue: Response returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true (CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*'). Playbook expects explicit origin list when credentials are allowed.

Body is a raw dict, not a Pydantic model: no validation of admin email format or password length server-side (only frontend enforces min 6 chars); a company can also be created with no admin at all (admin omitted -> admin: null) leaving an org with 0 users.

ui_bugs.issue: Deep-link or hard refresh of any /platform/* URL redirects to /platform/dashboard and loses the route. Reproduced: page.goto('/platform/companies') -> lands on /platform/dashboard; same for /platform/companies/new and /platform/companies/:id. Cause: while AuthContext is still loading (user === null), Shell renders the non-platform <Routes> whose '*' route does Navigate('/dashboard', replace), rewriting the URL before PlatformApp mounts. Fix: render the loading spinner in Shell while auth.loading is true, before any Routes.

New tenants see the seed tenants' branding. New FABRIC company 'QA UI Weave' shows sidebar brand 'Nayara Studio / ORDER STUDIO' and dashboard H1 'Nayara Studio'; new FLEET company 'QA UI Fleet' shows 'ROUTE39 FLEET' in the sidebar, 'Route39 Fleet Operations · All Cities' on the dashboard and 'Vehicle control system for the Route39 EV fleet' on /fleet. Hardcoded at AppShell.jsx:102, Dashboard.jsx:61, Fleet.jsx:55, Drivers.jsx:42, Rentals.jsx:39, NayaraDashboard.jsx:46, NayaraReports.jsx:34 — should use user.org_name (already returned by /auth/me).
admin-password uses a plain text input (value visible on screen, no type=password and no show/hide toggle).
Validation is toast-only; no inline field-level error styling/aria-invalid on the offending input, and the toast for the previous error stays stacked with the new one.

issues: Success screen and form are clean light theme, good contrast — no issues found
Two-column grid is not collapsed for narrow widths (grid-cols-2 fixed, no sm: breakpoint) so on mobile the Company/Admin inputs stay side-by-side and get very narrow
'Last Activity' shows an em dash for brand-new companies (acceptable) but there is no link/list of the company's users, so the platform admin cannot see the admin they just created from this page

action_items: Fix /platform/* deep-link/refresh: gate Shell on auth loading before rendering the catch-all '*' Navigate in App.js

Replace hardcoded 'Route39' / 'Nayara Studio' branding with user.org_name so newly onboarded companies see their own name (AppShell.jsx:102, Dashboard.jsx:61, Fleet.jsx:55, Drivers.jsx:42, Rentals.jsx:39, NayaraDashboard.jsx:46, NayaraReports.jsx:34)
Add server-side validation for POST /platform/companies (Pydantic model: EmailStr admin email, min_length 6 password, require admin block)
Mask the Temporary Password input (type=password + reveal toggle)
Set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins instead of '*' since credentials are allowed
Optional: make Add Company form grid responsive (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2)
critical_code_review_comments: POST /platform/companies accepts `body: dict` — no Pydantic schema; admin email/password are unvalidated server-side and an org can be created with no admin user.

Company code is derived with `.replace(' ', '-')` only on the backend while the frontend slugifies fully; a direct API call with 'My Co!' produces org_id 'my-co!' (unsanitised URL segment). Sanitise the slug server-side.
No rollback/transaction: if user insert fails after the org insert (e.g. unique email index race), the org is left behind with 0 users.
Tenant branding is hardcoded per seed org instead of driven by user.org_name — breaks multi-tenancy for every new company created by this flow.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of onboarding flow assertions passed; 2 defects found outside the happy path (deep-link refresh, tenant branding)

rca_of_the_issue: Deep-link bug: in App.js Shell(), the platform_admin branch is only taken once `user` is populated. During the initial auth bootstrap `user === null`, so the generic <Routes> render and the catch-all `<Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/dashboard' replace/>} />` immediately rewrites the URL; when the platform user resolves, PlatformApp mounts at /dashboard and its own '*' route sends it to /platform/dashboard. Fix by returning the loading spinner from Shell while useAuth().loading is true. Branding bug: AppShell.jsx line 102 hardcodes brand names per industry rather than using user.org_name from /auth/me.
